overrideNotes.minimatch, rollup, glob: vitest/vite toolchain — review on vite 6 upgrade
overrideNotes.express>path-to-regexp: medusa>express transitive fix — GHSA-37ch-88jc-xwx2 ReDoS. Scoped (not global) because @medusajs/framework declares path-to-regexp ^8.2.0 and uses the v6+ named-export API; forcing 0.1.13 globally crashes commerce at startup with 'pathToRegexp is not a function'. next@16 also declares 6.3.0 and would be silently downgraded. Remove when medusa drops express 4.
overrideNotes.lodash: medusa/prisma transitive fix — GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc code injection via _.template
overrideNotes.@types/react, @types/react-dom: medusa pulls React 18 types — force single version to fix JSX portability errors
overrideNotes.vite@7: vitest/qa-viewer>vite v7 transitive fix — GHSA-v2wj-q39q-566r + GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583 + GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff (server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths, patched 7.3.5). Bumped 7.3.2->7.3.5. Scoped to v7 so medusa's vite v5 is untouched. Remove when vitest pulls vite >= 7.3.5.
overrideNotes.form-data: apps/api>twilio>axios>form-data transitive fix — GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field names/filenames. Patched in 4.0.6+. Remove when twilio's axios pulls form-data >=4.0.6.
overrideNotes.@rushstack/node-core-library>ajv: @medusajs/cli>...>@rushstack/node-core-library>ajv transitive fix — GHSA-2g4f-4pwh-qvx6 ReDoS via $data option. Scoped (not global) because @eslint/eslintrc uses ajv v6 API and breaks if forced to v8 ('NOT SUPPORTED: option missingRefs' / 'Cannot set defaultMeta'). Remove when rushstack updates.
overrideNotes.esbuild: @medusajs/framework>vite v5>esbuild + .>tsx>esbuild transitive fix — GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 dev-server CORS (fixed in 0.25.0). Pinned to ^0.25.0, NOT 0.28.x: esbuild 0.28 lowers destructuring more strictly and crashes Medusa's admin-vite-plugin dep optimizer with thousands of 'Transforming destructuring to the configured target environment is not supported yet' errors against the @react-aria/@ariakit ESM (admin /app/login spins forever). The only advisory 0.28 added over 0.25 was GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr (Deno binary-integrity verification, N/A to this Node repo), so 0.25.x is fully sufficient. Remove when medusa upgrades vite to v6+.
overrideNotes.@grpc/grpc-js: apps/api>testcontainers>dockerode>@grpc/grpc-js transitive fix — GHSA-5375-pq7m-f5r2 (CVE-2026-48068) + GHSA-99f4-grh7-6pcq (CVE-2026-48069) malformed-request server crash. Test-only dependency (Testcontainers / dockerode). Patched in 1.14.4+.
overrideNotes.fast-jwt: apps/api>@fastify/jwt transitive fix — GHSA-rp9m-7r4c-75qg cache confusion + GHSA-gmvf-9v4p-v8jc (CVE-2026-44351) CRITICAL JWT auth bypass on empty HMAC secret. Patched in 6.2.4+. Remove when @fastify/jwt pulls fast-jwt >=6.2.4.
overrideNotes.fast-uri: apps/api>@fastify/swagger>json-schema-resolver + fastify transitive fix — GHSA-q3j6-qgpj-74h6 (CVE-2026-6321) path traversal + GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc (CVE-2026-6322) host confusion. Patched in 3.1.2+.
overrideNotes.axios: apps/api>twilio transitive fix — CVE-2026-42033/42035/42043/44486-44496 cluster (prototype pollution, proxy-auth credential leak, MITM, ReDoS, NO_PROXY bypass). Patched in 1.16.0+. Remove when twilio pulls axios >=1.16.0.
overrideNotes.protobufjs: apps/api>@sentry/node transitive fix — GHSA-xq3m-2v4x-88gg arbitrary code execution + CVE-2026-44289/44290/44291/44293 code injection + DoS. Patched in 8.0.2+. @sentry/node's OTLP encoder serializes only fixed internal schemas (never user-supplied .proto), so the major bump is purely hardening.
overrideNotes.fastify: apps/api direct dep fix — GHSA-247c-9743-5963 body schema validation bypass via leading-space Content-Type. Patched in 5.8.5+.
overrideNotes.next: apps/admin + apps/web direct dep fix — GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3 DoS via Server Components + the CVE-2026-44573..45109 middleware/proxy-bypass, SSRF and DoS cluster. Patched in 16.2.6+.
overrideNotes.@opentelemetry/sdk-node, @opentelemetry/: apps/api transitive fix — GHSA-q7rr-3cgh-j5r3 (CVE-2026-44902) Prometheus exporter process crash via malformed HTTP. Patched in 0.217.0+.
overrideNotes.tmp: transitive fix — GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65 (CVE-2026-44705) path traversal via unsanitized prefix/postfix. Patched in 0.2.6+.
overrideNotes.fast-xml-builder: transitive fix — GHSA-5wm8-gmm8-39j9 (CVE-2026-44665) attribute-value injection. Patched in 1.1.7+.

ignoreCveNotes.CVE-2026-35042: fast-jwt <=6.1.0 GHSA-hm7r-c7qw-ghp6 — accepts unknown `crit` header extensions (RFC 7515 violation). No upstream patch released yet. Mitigation: we never set or trust `crit` headers in our JWT flow (Twilio Verify OTP only). Re-check when nearform/fast-jwt ships a fix.
ignoreCveNotes.CVE-2026-44680: @mikro-orm/knex SQL injection (GHSA-cfw5-68c4-ffqp, patched >=6.6.14) — same situation + mitigation as the @mikro-orm/core advisories below: pulled exclusively by @medusajs/deps, which pins the MikroORM 6.4.x line; forcing 6.6.x crashes Medusa's service bootstrap (the 6.4→6.6 EventManager subscribers Array→Set change). Mitigation: nothing in this repo runs user-controlled queries through MikroORM — Medusa is the only consumer and all its query paths are parameterized. Remove when Medusa upgrades MikroORM.
ignoreCveNotes.CVE-2026-47429: vitest <4.1.0 (GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp) — arbitrary file read ONLY while the Vitest UI server (`vitest --ui`) is listening. Not exploitable here: CI and local both run `vitest run` (no UI server) and we never start the UI. The only patch is vitest 4.x (a breaking major); ignored rather than forcing a 3→4 upgrade of the whole test toolchain. Re-check when the suite migrates to vitest 4.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9: Documentation only — not enforced (pnpm ignoreCves only matches CVE-* IDs). vite <=6.4.1 path traversal in optimized deps .map handling. Pulled by @medusajs/framework which has a hard peer dep on `vite ^5.4.21`, so we cannot override to 6.4.2+ without breaking medusa's admin-vite-plugin. Dev-server-only vuln, not exploitable in production builds. Stays as a moderate in audit output (below the --audit-level=high CI threshold). Remove when medusa upgrades to vite v6+.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-gwhv-j974-6fxm: Documentation only — not enforced (pnpm ignoreCves only matches CVE-* IDs). @mikro-orm/core SQL injection. Pulled exclusively by @medusajs/deps@2.13.5 which pins @mikro-orm/core to 6.4.16. Cannot override to a patched 6.6.x line because @medusajs/utils was built against MikroORM 6.4's EventManager (subscribers is an Array with .some()); 6.6+ switched subscribers to a Set, so registerInternalServiceEventSubscriber crashes on the first service bootstrap. Mitigation: nothing in this repo executes user-controlled queries through MikroORM — Medusa is the only consumer and all its query paths are parameterized. Re-check when Medusa upgrades to MikroORM 6.6+ or 7.x.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-qpfv-44f3-qqx6: Documentation only — same situation and mitigation as GHSA-gwhv-j974-6fxm. Second SQL injection advisory against the same @mikro-orm/core 6.4.x line pulled via @medusajs/deps@2.13.5. Paired tracking — remove both together when Medusa bumps MikroORM.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr: esbuild <0.28.1 — Deno binary-integrity verification bypass, N/A to this Node repo (we never run the esbuild Deno binary). Re-introduced deliberately by pinning esbuild to ^0.25.0: esbuild 0.28 lowers destructuring more strictly and crashes Medusa's admin-vite-plugin dep optimizer against the @react-aria/@ariakit ESM (admin /app/login spins forever), so 0.28 is not usable here. 0.25.x already fixes the only OTHER esbuild advisory (GHSA-67mh dev-server CORS). Remove when medusa upgrades vite to v6+ and esbuild 0.28 becomes usable.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff: vite `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths. The vitest + qa-viewer instances (vite v7) ARE fixed via the `vite@7: 7.3.5` override above. The ONLY remaining instance is `@medusajs/framework>vite` (v5.x), which has no patched release in the 5.x line (patched is >=6.4.3) and cannot be overridden because medusa hard-pins `vite ^5.4.21` (forcing v6 breaks medusa's admin-vite-plugin — see the GHSA-4w7w note). Dev-server-only vuln (we run `vitest run` + production builds, never a long-lived vite dev server) and Windows-only; not exploitable here. Remove when medusa upgrades to vite v6+.
